scripts.install:hc: bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh holochain $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_hc_version && bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh hc $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_hc_version && bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh kitsune2-bootstrap-srv-iroh-relay $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_hc_version
scripts.version: hc --version & holochain --version & lair-keystore --version & zits --version & echo "Typescript $(tsc --version)" & echo "Weave $(weave --version)"
scripts.build:zome: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom" -C link-arg=--import-undefined' cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.build:dna: npm run build:zome && hc dna pack -o artifacts/where.dna dna/workdir/dna-where && hc dna pack -o artifacts/ludotheque.dna dna/workdir/dna-ludotheque
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:dna && hc app pack -o artifacts/where.happ dna/workdir/happ-where && hc app pack -o artifacts/where-standalone.happ dna/workdir/happ-where-standalone && hc app pack -o artifacts/ludotheque.happ dna/workdir/happ-ludotheque
scripts.extract:localize: npm run localize:extract -w webcomponents && npm run localize:extract -w webapp
scripts.build:localize: npm run localize:build -w webcomponents && npm run localize:build -w webapp
scripts.build:webapp: npm run build:localize && npm run build -w webcomponents && npm run build -w webapp
scripts.build:devtest: npm run clean:hc & npm run build:happ && npm run build -w webcomponents
scripts.devtest: npm run build:devtest && npm run start:mem
scripts.start:mem: FORCE_COLOR=0 RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=debug UI_PORT=$(port) HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run new-sandbox:mem" "sleep 7 && npm run start -w webapp"
scripts.new-sandbox:mem: echo "pass" | hc s --holochain-path holochain --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT generate artifacts/where.happ --run=$HC_APP_PORT -a where
scripts.spintest: UI_PORT=$(port) HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run spin" "sleep 5 && npm run start -w webapp"
scripts.weave: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -u GDK_PIXBUF_MODULE_FILE -u GIO_EXTRA_MODULES -u GIO_MODULE_DIR -u GSETTINGS_SCHEMAS_PATH XDG_DATA_DIRS=/usr/local/share:/usr/share TS_NODE_COMPILER_OPTIONS='{"module":"commonjs","target":"es2020","esModuleInterop":true}' weave
scripts.launch:moss: concurrently "UI_PORT=1420 npm run start:ui:tool" "sleep 1 && npm run weave -- --agent-idx 1 --dev-config weave.dev.config.ts" "sleep 20 && npm run weave -- --agent-idx 2 --sync-time 45000 --dev-config weave.dev.config.ts"
scripts.launch:moss-1: concurrently "UI_PORT=1420 npm run start:ui:tool" "sleep 1 && npm run weave -- --agent-idx 1 --dev-config weave.dev.config.ts"
scripts.start:moss: npm run build:happ && npm run build -w webcomponents && npm run launch:moss
scripts.start:moss-1: npm run build:happ && npm run build -w webcomponents && npm run launch:moss-1
scripts.dist:tool: npm run build -w webcomponents && npm run build -w webapp && npm run dist -w moss-tool && npm run package:tool
scripts.package:tool: rm -rf artifacts/where-moss-tool-ui.zip & cd moss-tool/dist && rm -f *.map && bestzip ../../artifacts/where-moss-tool-ui.zip * && cd ../../ && hc web-app pack moss-tool/webhapp.workdir -o artifacts/where-moss-tool.webhapp
scripts.package: npm run build:happ && npm run build:localize && npm run dist:tool && npm run hash
scripts.package:webapp: rm -rf artifacts/where-webapp-ui.zip & cd webapp/dist && rm -f *.map && bestzip ../../artifacts/where-webapp-ui.zip * && cd ../../ && hc web-app pack webapp/webhapp.workdir -o artifacts/where.webhapp
